n9a52f039b1.headline: RI, Kazakhstan eye new trade corridor to boost economic ties
n9a52f039b1.summary: Indonesia and Kazakhstan have agreed to develop a bilateral trade corridor to strengthen economic relations. The agreement follows ratification of a related deal.
n9a52f039b1.why: Bilateral trade corridors can lower logistics costs and expand export opportunities between the two economies.

n5913fca023.headline: Stock markets rally for 2nd day on easing crude oil prices, buying in IT firms
n5913fca023.summary: Sensex and Nifty ended nearly one per cent higher on Thursday as crude oil prices softened. Positive geopolitical developments and buying in blue-chip IT stocks also supported the rally.
n5913fca023.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indices of India's stock market, and India is a large net importer of crude oil, so oil prices affect its markets.
n5913fca023.why_moved: Softening crude oil prices, positive geopolitical developments and buying in blue-chip IT stocks lifted the benchmark indices.

nd111baf447.headline: Ringgit closes higher against greenback, regional currencies
nd111baf447.summary: The ringgit closed higher against the greenback and regional currencies. Traders watched Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's remarks at the European Central Bank Forum, where he gave no forward guidance on rates.
nd111baf447.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves reflect expectations for US interest rates, which drive capital flows into and out of emerging Asian markets.

nca4f540e82.headline: Zambia extends petrol and diesel tax exemptions until September
nca4f540e82.summary: Zambia has extended its suspension of excise duty and value added tax on petrol and diesel for 90 days, effective July 1 until September 30. The information ministry announced the extension.
nca4f540e82.why: Fuel taxes feed directly into transport and food costs. Changes to fuel tax policy affect inflation and government revenue in import-dependent economies.

nb401131bac.headline: Ukraine Opens 'Transparent' Wartime Arms Export Drive
nb401131bac.summary: Ukraine's government announced a transparent wartime arms export framework intended to raise defence funds, officials said.
nb401131bac.why: Arms exports generate foreign revenue for Ukraine's wartime budget, and the policy affects the country's defence industry and its external financing needs.

n5200d76354.headline: Iran holds mass funeral prayer for slain supreme leader - World News
n5200d76354.summary: The body of Iran's supreme leader, killed in US-Israeli strikes that triggered the Middle East war, arrived at Tehran's Grand Mosalla ahead of his funeral, state media reported.
n5200d76354.why: Strikes and conflict in the Middle East affect oil supply expectations and regional risk premiums that global investors monitor closely.

nc0badb4542.headline: Services in Nairobi Under Threat as MCAs Reject 2026/2027 Budget - Ghetto Radio
nc0badb4542.summary: A group of Nairobi County Assembly members led by the majority leader rejected the KES 46.98 billion 2026/2027 budget, calling it a sham and warning about service delivery.
nc0badb4542.why: County budgets determine public spending on services in Nairobi, Kenya's capital and economic hub, affecting local infrastructure and fiscal policy.

source.name: Ghetto Radio - Kenya's Number 1 Ghetto Radio

sources.name: Ghetto Radio - Kenya's Number 1 Ghetto Radio

n374162b60a.headline: The EU-Mercosur deal will require 'sacrifices' from Argentina, experts warn
n374162b60a.summary: European diplomats say the EU-Mercosur agreement will bring large gains in exports and investment. Experts warn both blocs will have to adapt to new competition and trade rules, with Argentina making sacrifices.
n374162b60a.why: The EU-Mercosur deal would cut trade barriers between the European Union and four South American economies, reshaping agricultural, industrial and investment flows.

n21934564cd.headline: U.S. job market slows in June
n21934564cd.summary: U.S. employers added 57,000 jobs in June, the Labor Department said, with job growth slowing from the previous two months. The unemployment rate ticked down to 4.2%.
n21934564cd.why: Monthly U.S. payroll data is a key gauge of labor-market strength, shaping expectations for Federal Reserve interest-rate policy and the outlook for borrowing costs and equities.
n21934564cd.why_moved: Job growth slowed from the previous two months while unemployment edged down, a mixed labor signal that bears on expectations for Federal Reserve policy.

n5b33f7b199.headline: Australian services activity returns to growth but confidence hits 2.5-year low
n5b33f7b199.summary: Australian services activity edged back into growth in June, but falling orders and collapsing confidence clouded the outlook. Confidence has reached its lowest level in about 2.5 years.
n5b33f7b199.why: Services make up most of Australia's economy, so the services activity gauge is a key read on domestic growth.

nd2c7ca61ab.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Is Betting On AI. He Says The Revolution Is Just Getting Started.
nd2c7ca61ab.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said the United States is likely to be a big winner from artificial intelligence, describing the technology as a structural shift in the global economy.
nd2c7ca61ab.why: The Federal Reserve's views on structural trends like AI can shape expectations for productivity, growth and monetary policy.

nc854cf889c.headline: Pune Metro Line 3 Expected To Boost Real Estate Growth Across Western Pune
nc854cf889c.summary: As Pune Metro Line 3 nears commercial operations, real estate experts believe the project will further strengthen western Pune's property market.
nc854cf889c.why: Metro infrastructure typically raises property values and development activity along its route.

n1d19600060.headline: Next Israeli gov't main issue controlling defense budget, Bank Hapoalim CEO | The Jerusalem Post
n1d19600060.summary: Bank Hapoalim CEO Yadin Antebi said controlling the defence budget will be the main issue for the next Israeli government. He told EY's annual real estate conference that the budget would heavily shape living standards in coming years.
n1d19600060.why: Bank Hapoalim is one of Israel's largest banks, and government spending priorities affect public finances and the economy.

n7a7a57631a.headline: Vietnam, Philippines upgraded to upper-middle income status
n7a7a57631a.summary: Vietnam and the Philippines have been upgraded to upper-middle-income status, and all five major Southeast Asian economies are now in that tier or higher.
n7a7a57631a.why: Income classification affects borrowing terms, development financing and investor perceptions of a country's growth stage.

ndcd3227e64.headline: Labor-led committee calls for tougher NDIS fraud rules
ndcd3227e64.summary: A Labor-led committee has called for tougher fraud rules for the National Disability Insurance Scheme. An overhaul could see hundreds of thousands of Australians lose access to the scheme.
ndcd3227e64.why: The NDIS is Australia's large government-funded disability insurance scheme, with major federal spending. Changes to eligibility and fraud controls affect public budgets and service providers.

n11d4477b6d.headline: #economy: Home Building Rebounds as New Dwelling Consents Climb 19 Percent
n11d4477b6d.summary: New Zealand's residential construction sector is showing renewed momentum, with new home consents rising 19 percent over the past year. The data signal growing confidence in the housing market.
n11d4477b6d.why: Building consents are a leading indicator of future residential construction activity and housing supply. They are closely tracked by economists and the central bank.

ncb7124f6bf.headline: Indonesia, Belarus push trade pact as FTA ratification progresses
ncb7124f6bf.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto said Indonesia is in the process of ratifying its free trade agreement with the Eurasian Economic Union. Indonesia and Belarus are pushing the trade pact forward.
ncb7124f6bf.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and can expand market access for exporters. The Eurasian Economic Union links Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Armenia and Kyrgyzstan.

n463b072cfd.headline: #economy: Government Finances Beat Forecasts as Economy Shows Signs of Recovery
n463b072cfd.summary: New Zealand's government posted a deficit around $3 billion lower than forecast, with its financial position improving faster than expected. New national accounts data point to a strengthening economy.
n463b072cfd.why: Fiscal results shape government borrowing needs and bond supply. Public finances are a key input for New Zealand's sovereign debt and interest rate outlook.

n1e45f7ed30.headline: Crude oil trades lower as US and Iran conclude indirect talks
n1e45f7ed30.summary: Crude oil prices fell as indirect US-Iran talks concluded without agreement. Brent traded at $70.83 and WTI at $67.84.
n1e45f7ed30.why: Brent and WTI are the main global crude benchmarks, and their prices feed through to fuel costs, inflation and energy-company earnings.
n1e45f7ed30.why_moved: The absence of a deal between the US and Iran removes hopes of easing Gulf supply tensions, pressuring prices.

nc16cabeee2.headline: Australia ranks third-highest for median wealth globally, UBS data shows
nc16cabeee2.summary: Australia has the third-highest median wealth globally at $306,074, according to UBS data. Only Luxembourg and Belgium rank higher.
nc16cabeee2.why: Median household wealth is a gauge of consumer resilience and the capacity for household spending and borrowing.

ne29054cb65.headline: Japan Takes Next Step In $2.3 Trillion Plan With Domestic AI Model And 10M Robots
ne29054cb65.summary: Japan is taking the next step in a $2.3 trillion plan that includes a domestic AI model and 10 million robots. The effort reflects a wider push for sovereign AI capabilities.
ne29054cb65.why: Government-backed AI and robotics programs shape domestic demand for technology hardware and the competitive position of Japanese industry.

n6fb393d9ed.headline: Yen surged against dollar
n6fb393d9ed.summary: The yen gained strongly against the dollar as traders anticipated potential action from Japanese authorities. Signals of a new policy aimed at strengthening the weak currency drove the move.
n6fb393d9ed.why: The yen is a major funding and reserve currency, and its moves affect Japanese exporters, import costs and carry trades.

source.name: Shafaqna English | International Shia News & Fatwas

sources.name: Shafaqna English | International Shia News & Fatwas

n6fb393d9ed.why_moved: Traders priced in potential Japanese policy action aimed at strengthening the currency.

nd5cc42de55.headline: China’s Hengli scraps West African, Mideast oil purchases and cuts output, sources say
nd5cc42de55.summary: Sanctioned refiner Hengli Petrochemical has cancelled recent purchases of non-Iranian crude, according to trade sources. It is cutting refinery operations further as inventories run low.
nd5cc42de55.why: Hengli is a large Chinese refiner, and changes in its crude buying affect regional oil demand and refined product supply.

nb1e2bc4d00.headline: U.S. and Iran hold separate meetings in Qatar and agree to continue discussions
nb1e2bc4d00.summary: US and Iranian negotiators met separately on Wednesday with Qatari and Pakistani mediators, reporting positive progress and agreeing to continue discussions, Qatar said.
nb1e2bc4d00.why: Negotiations between Washington and Tehran shape sanctions, shipping security and oil supply expectations across the Gulf region.

n1eebaede8f.headline: Europe growth hit more by China exports than bigger trade gap, Goldman says
n1eebaede8f.summary: Goldman Sachs says the bigger drag on European Union growth is losing market share to China rather than a widening trade deficit with the Asian country.
n1eebaede8f.why: Export competitiveness against China affects European industrial earnings, growth forecasts and trade policy debates.

n7bf8d3970d.headline: GLOBAL MARKETS-Dollar Slides After Jobs Data, Chipmakers Weigh on Stocks
n7bf8d3970d.summary: US employers added 57,000 jobs in June against expectations of 110,000. South Korea's KOSPI slumped nearly 8% and the US chip index fell 5.5%.
n7bf8d3970d.why: Payroll data is a key input for Federal Reserve rate expectations, which drive the dollar and global equity valuations. Chipmakers are major index weights.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index fell nearly 8% in the same session as the US jobs data was reported.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n7bf8d3970d.why_moved: A weak US jobs print lowered the outlook for the economy and rate decisions, and the dollar weakened. Chip stocks sold off sharply in the US and Korea.

n543a0a607e.headline: OPEC+ Plans Another Output Hike. The Market Barely Notices.
n543a0a607e.summary: OPEC+ is expected to approve another production quota increase for August as Gulf oil output gradually recovers following the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
n543a0a607e.why: OPEC+ sets production quotas for a large share of global oil supply, shaping crude prices.

n8510e7ea22.headline: 'Positive progress' in US-Iran talks in Doha, says Pakistan | Rediff-TV | Rediff.com
n8510e7ea22.summary: Pakistan and Qatar mediated separate meetings between US and Iranian negotiators in Doha. Both reported positive progress on a memorandum of understanding, with further talks planned.
n8510e7ea22.why: Diplomatic progress between the US and Iran affects Gulf energy supply risk and regional market sentiment.

n5ed1fafb42.headline: Kuwait Wants Consortiums to Bid for $7 Billion Oil Pipeline Deal
n5ed1fafb42.summary: Kuwait's KPC is asking bidders for its $7 billion oil pipeline stake sale to form consortiums, with BlackRock and KKR among those advancing.
n5ed1fafb42.why: KPC is Kuwait's state oil company, and stake sales in energy infrastructure attract large infrastructure investors.

n752068d41f.headline: KKR And SK Launch South Korea's Largest Renewable Energy Platform
n752068d41f.summary: KKR and SK Inc are launching the largest renewable energy platform in South Korea. It aims to meet growing power demand from AI and chip manufacturing.
n752068d41f.why: KKR is a global investment firm, and renewable platforms backed by private capital are increasingly used to fund power for data centers and chip fabs.

n5162b43a78.headline: Pertamina ready to roll out B50 biodiesel ahead of July 2026 launch
n5162b43a78.summary: State-owned Pertamina said it is ready to distribute B50 biodiesel ahead of the program's scheduled launch by President Prabowo.
n5162b43a78.why: Pertamina is Indonesia's state oil and gas company, and biodiesel mandates affect its fuel supply and import needs.

n0c81c93088.headline: Saudi Aramco Ramps up Exports From Ras Tanura, Switches to Spot Sales, Sources Say
n0c81c93088.summary: At least five supertankers carrying 10 million barrels of Saudi oil loaded at Ras Tanura have exited the Strait of Hormuz. Aramco has switched to spot pricing to speed sales in Asia, sources said.
n0c81c93088.why: Saudi Aramco is the state oil company of Saudi Arabia and a major global crude supplier, so its export decisions influence oil flows and prices.

nf38a96a528.headline: Indonesia rail fleet fully prepared for B50 biofuel shift
nf38a96a528.summary: State-owned rail operator PT Kereta Api Indonesia says its entire diesel fleet is ready to switch to B50 biodiesel. The move follows Indonesia's biofuel mandate shift.
nf38a96a528.why: Indonesia mandates biodiesel blending in diesel fuel, which supports domestic palm oil demand and reduces fossil fuel imports.

n940f3b1198.headline: Pertamina ship clearance in Hormuz ongoing after first vessel exit
n940f3b1198.summary: Indonesia's state-owned Pertamina confirmed the clearance phase is ongoing for the Pertamina Pride very large crude carrier before it can exit the Strait of Hormuz. The first vessel has already exited.
n940f3b1198.why: Pertamina is Indonesia's state oil company, and Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global crude and product shipments.

n3abba1b07e.headline: China moves to restrict some Fortescue iron ore cargoes
n3abba1b07e.summary: China Mineral Resources Group has notified some steel mills they must not take delivery of portside cargoes of Fortescue iron ore.
n3abba1b07e.why: Fortescue is an Australian iron ore miner, and China is the largest buyer of seaborne iron ore, so Chinese purchasing restrictions affect its sales.

n5e687463fb.headline: What's Behind The Plunging Won And Sudden Liquidity Collapse In Korean Markets
n5e687463fb.summary: A surge in onshore retail margin trading and leveraged single-stock ETFs raised funding needs at local securities firms, causing a sudden liquidity squeeze in Korean markets.
n5e687463fb.why: The won is South Korea's currency, and leveraged retail trading through local brokers can force sudden funding strain that spreads to the wider equity market.
n5e687463fb.why_moved: Surging onshore retail margin trading and leveraged single-stock ETFs sharply raised funding needs at local securities firms. That led to a liquidity squeeze in Korean markets and a plunge in the won.

nf4b934bb22.headline: Sri Lanka upgraded to upper-middle income economy by World Bank
nf4b934bb22.summary: The World Bank has upgraded Sri Lanka to upper-middle-income status, marking a significant recovery after its economic crisis.
nf4b934bb22.why: The World Bank income classification affects Sri Lanka's access to concessional financing and shapes investor perception of its recovery.

n3d5ccc6a24.headline: Vehicle imports rise 20% in May
n3d5ccc6a24.summary: Sri Lanka's imports of personal and commercial vehicles rose 20% in May from April, reaching $250 million, according to the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.
n3d5ccc6a24.why: Vehicle import spending affects Sri Lanka's foreign-exchange demand and is closely tracked by the central bank as a sign of consumer and import activity.

n4f7aed6753.headline: Alibaba's Ant Group Started Investing in Humanoid Robots Last Year. They've Made A Dozen Deals Since And Bet It's The Future.
n4f7aed6753.summary: Alibaba affiliate Ant Group is leading a new $73.6 million funding round for Chinese startup Zeroth. Ant has reportedly made a dozen humanoid robotics deals since last year.
n4f7aed6753.why: Ant Group is the financial technology affiliate of Alibaba, and its venture investments signal where Chinese capital is flowing in robotics and AI.

ne9d79de152.headline: Mortgage demand from home buyers expected by lenders to fall over summer
ne9d79de152.summary: Lenders in the UK anticipate a fall in mortgage demand from home buyers and remortgaging activity during the summer months.
ne9d79de152.why: Mortgage demand trends affect housing market activity, bank lending, and consumer spending.
